$description: Dakit semantic layer, light theme (the default). Roles only: components and apps may use these, never the primitive ramps. Values may alias primitives with '{ramp.step}' references. Every text/background pair used together is contrast-checked at build time (see tokens/contrast.json).

spinner.$description: The one loading indicator (.dk-spinner, and the ring a busy .dk-button draws). size fits inside a sm button; size-lg is the centred loading overlay. color is the arc and track the rest of the ring on a surface; inside a button the arc takes the button's text colour instead. duration is one full turn; with reduced motion the ring stands still.

loading.$description: Load-before-open timing (docs/dialog-loading.md). A dialog that needs data opens only once the data is in; until then the trigger is busy. delay-busy: how long a load may take before any spinner shows, so fast loads never flicker. delay-overlay: how long a busy button may wait before the centred loading overlay takes over (a trigger with no room for a spinner, like a row, gets the overlay at delay-busy).

gap.$description: Layout rhythm by role, so apps stop inventing 6/10/14px gaps. control: between adjacent interactive controls (also the row gap when a group wraps). block: between a block (table, panel, empty state, form) and the controls before or after it. section: between page sections.

pad.$description: Inner padding by role. cell: table cells and divided rows. panel: inside a bordered panel or card.
